column1: # Phonology overrides (PRP3, docs/PHONOLOGY_REWRITE_PLAN.md): hand-edited, committed, applied in memory when STENALGO_PHONOLOGY_REWRITE=1.
# kind      spelling  phonology  base   gramcat  note
#   phonology: every reading of the spelling is typed with the given phonology (a single vowel-less syllable of onset phonemes).
#   elided:    the spelling is the elided form of `base` and ranks right after it in the star/hash order (PRP4, PRP19). When the
#              lexicon has no row for it (j', c', qu'), one reading is created from each frequent reading of `base` with the given
#              phonology; when it has rows, the phonology column stays empty.
#   drop:      the reading (spelling, gramcat) is removed from the theory: a junk reading whose family (`me` NOM, plural `mes`) would drag the
#              spelling's star/hash node into conflicts with other strokes (`mes` with mais/met), so the base could not be bare.
# A phoneme written in a `phonology` row is pinned: the optionality search and retirement never remove it (PRB4).

column6: junk reading (freq 2.6, plural mes): ties the pronoun me to the mais/met cluster, so me was not bare
